delivery.intro: Allegro Delivery ("Wysyłam z Allegro") labels are issued via Allegro's shipment-management API and tracked automatically:
delivery.labelCreation: Label creation is synchronous from OpenLinker's side - operators generate a label from the order detail panel; OpenLinker waits for Allegro's command to complete before responding.
delivery.pickupPoints: Buyer-selected pickup points (Allegro One Box, Paczkomat, kurier) are pre-filled on the label form from the order snapshot.
delivery.summary: No configuration needed - how shipment tracking works
delivery.title: Allegro Delivery
delivery.trackingNumber: Tracking number resolves asynchronously. Allegro generates the waybill on a delay; OpenLinker polls every 15 minutes and backfills the row when it arrives (no manual refresh needed).

setupCard.description: Connect an Allegro seller account. Authorization uses OAuth 2.0 - no manual token paste.
